handlerBehavior.highDecimalTruncationRisk: Feeds above 18 decimals can normalize to zero; zero numerator can satisfy the trigger and zero denominator reverts.
handlerBehavior.arithmeticLimits: Signed scaling and normalized numerator times 10^18 must fit int256. Excessive maximum age can underflow block.timestamp subtraction.

decision: No production route approved. Bounded USD buy-feed compatibility is not established. Arbitrum, Base, and Linea also lack required execution-time sequencer protection. Browser checks do not protect future execution.
limits: This records a bounded source and deployment review, not a security audit, proof of feed quality, or execution guarantee. Source/input evidence is not a production route approval. No transactions were sent.
